product_from_film: Rork Max presents AI app creation for Apple devices, with installation and publishing controls.
explains_well: A consistent device-and-label layout makes the range of app types and platforms easy to follow.
unclear: No prompt-to-build sequence supports the one-shot promise, and the App Store headline jumps ahead of the visible publishing state.
scenario: Show apps across Apple devices, then install a productivity app and open publishing options.
product_clear_basis: Opening text identifies AI app creation and shows example phone apps.
